context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
In plain words: the PR ledger lists pull requests waiting on a review. The coordinator's pick gave a stalled review a flag after 72 hours. That is a fixed time limit, which you said you do not approve (your 11:36 CST Nov 13 words, R37), and the 72 was a guess. That is why it does not make sense.
Problem (goal): the pick also says a record marked done whose lane check never passed belongs to its lane, not to the batch runner. That part is not about time.
Based on (notes): coordinator 12:10 CST Nov 12, from its list of picks; R37 and your 11:36 CST Nov 13 words.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: No guessed time limit; the ownership fix stays.
options.how: The ledger flags a stalled review by a measured age, once step pr-ledger-round-ages has measured how old rounds get. A record marked done whose lane check never passed belongs to its lane.
options.label: Drop the 72 h number; keep the ownership part (triage's proposal)
options.lose: A stalled review is not flagged by age until the measure exists.

options.gain: The other route, if you prefer it.
options.how: No age flag and no ownership change in the ledger.
options.label: Overrule the whole pick
options.lose: A record marked done with no passing lane check still has no owner.

reply: You said this does not make sense. It did not: the pick used a fixed 72 h limit, which you have said you do not approve. I rewrote it: a drops the number and keeps the ownership part; b overrules everything. Please answer again.
short: PR ledger: a 72 h limit for fix checks and later rounds

shown.label: Drop the 72 h number; keep the ownership part (triage's proposal)

title: PR ledger: a 72 h limit for fix checks and later rounds
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
